# Stage 31 Frontier Ledger

The exact identity `E(U)=Phi(U^{-1})` makes Fréchet dispersion a physical,
gauge-covariant retained variable. Covering failure forces energy `>eta^2`,
doubling the former local Gibbs exponent. This correction is exact.

The result does not yet include radial integration entropy or compare the bad
weighted numerator to a retained-state good partition. Those are the next
obligations.
